description: This file defines the BraketClient class, a specialized AWS SDK client for interacting with the Amazon Braket quantum computing service. It declares method signatures for various operations like creating, canceling, and searching quantum jobs and devices.

classes.name: BraketClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Braket service, extending the base AwsClient class, with methods for managing quantum tasks and devices.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a quantum job as specified by the arguments.

methods.name: createJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new quantum job.

methods.name: createQuantumTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new quantum task.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves information about a quantum device.

methods.name: getDeviceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a quantum device.

methods.name: getJob
methods.description: Retrieves information about a quantum job.

methods.name: getJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a quantum job.

methods.name: getQuantumTask
methods.description: Retrieves information about a quantum task.

methods.name: getQuantumTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a quantum task.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
